relationships.evidence_note: Harry Hallberg founded a boatyard at Kungsviken, Orust in 1943; later relocated to Ellös. Rassy purchased this yard on Hallberg's retirement in 1972, forming Hallberg-Rassy.
Christoph Rassy arrived in Sweden in 1960 and started his own yard in the mid-1960s in the premises Hallberg had vacated at Kungsviken; the two never operated as partners before the 1972 merger.

series_production_evidence: Official company history states approximately 9,800 yachts delivered since founding; continuous numbered production-model line (HR 34, 40, 44, 48, 50, 57, etc.) built at Ellös, Orust since 1972.
